# `effectFnOpportunity`

Suggests using Effect.fn for functions that return an Effect

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377047` |
| Language Service name | `effectFnOpportunity` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/effect-fn-opportunity` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"

export const preview = () => Effect.gen(function*() {
/**
             ^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(effect-fn-opportunity): This expression can be rewritten in the reusable function form `Effect.fn(function*() { ... })`.
*/
  return yield* Effect.succeed(1)
})
```
